purpose: Activate the M0-04 Configuration Contract, its generated artifact source, and the exact coverage and focused mutation selections required by issue #5 without publishing runtime state or claiming qualification.

change.scope_activation: M0-04 behavior ownership replaces only the historical M0-01 configuration scaffold activation for positron-config.
change.coverage_command: cargo +nightly-2026-07-20 llvm-cov --locked --package positron-config --test configuration_foundation --branch --json --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex crates/positron-config/tests/.* --output-path target/quality/coverage/m0-04-config.json

coverage_floor.branch: measured and retained; final exact-head baseline remains pending

change.mutation_rule: Any viable surviving or timed-out selected invariant mutant fails the cargo-mutants command and therefore EG-COVERAGE.
change.matrix_change: EG-MATRIX now regenerates and byte-compares configuration/schema.json and configuration/reference.md from configuration/spec.tsv in addition to the existing canonical API artifacts.
change.workflow_change: .github/workflows/extended.yml exposes the mutually exclusive retain_m0_04_mutation dispatch and retains target/quality for the exact workflow revision.

dependency_review.necessity: The Configuration Contract requires standards-compliant TOML comments, escapes, duplicate-key rejection, and malformed-document rejection; the removed handwritten line parser could not supply that contract.
dependency_review.bounded_use: The complete document is limited to 16384 bytes before parsing. The accepted value tree is then limited to depth 2, 16 entries, 64-byte keys, 256-byte scalar strings, known setting paths, and exact integer or string value shapes. No file I/O or ambient environment reading is delegated to the dependency.
dependency_review.maintenance_review: toml-rs is the maintained Rust TOML implementation used through its current exact release; its declared rust-version is below the repository's pinned Rust 1.96 toolchain.
dependency_review.security_review: Rejected parser diagnostics are collapsed to Positron's closed InvalidSyntax code and never expose source bytes. Cargo Audit, Cargo Deny, Cargo Vet, secret scanning, and the Configuration canary tests remain blocking.
dependency_review.removal_condition: Remove if the Rust standard library gains the required bounded standards-compliant TOML parser or an accepted Configuration Contract ADR changes the file format.
dependency_review.cargo_deny: Exact lower and upper version bans were added for toml 1.1.4; advisories, bans, licenses, and sources pass.

cargo_vet.first_result: failed closed on 15 newly resolved crates
cargo_vet.final_local_result: passed with 3 fully audited and 22 exact-version safe-to-deploy exemptions in the complete workspace graph
cargo_vet.qualification_limit: Exact exemptions are recorded policy, not independent audits or a qualification claim.

compatibility_and_migration.intentional_break: A supplied TOML document without an explicit root schema_version is now rejected with MissingSchemaVersion from SchemaVersion. Compiled defaults still own version 1 only when no file source is supplied.
compatibility_and_migration.unsupported_version_behavior: A declared non-v1 version is rejected with UnsupportedValue from SchemaVersion.
compatibility_and_migration.syntax_migration: Valid TOML inline comments and escapes are now accepted. Malformed tables, duplicate keys, arrays or unsupported scalar shapes, unknown settings, excessive depth, and excessive sizes fail closed.
compatibility_and_migration.source_precedence: Compiled defaults, file, non-secret environment, and non-secret command-line precedence is unchanged.
compatibility_and_migration.secret_behavior: Environment and command-line secret overrides remain forbidden. Raw input wrappers now use bounded redacted Debug implementations; generated and effective references retain only the redaction marker.
compatibility_and_migration.publication_boundary: No watcher, file reader, global singleton, runtime publication, task spawning, remote provider, or live reload executor is introduced.

old.limitations: The candidate retained the handwritten TOML parser, leaked raw override values through derived Debug, defaulted a missing file schema version, and did not implement cargo xtask generate-config. Its pass is retained but is not evidence for the replacement detector set.

detection_gained: File-backed configuration cannot silently inherit a compiled schema version; missing and unsupported versions have stable typed outcomes.
A maintained standards-compliant TOML parser accepts comments and escapes while rejecting malformed or duplicate documents before publication.
Raw environment, command-line, and file input wrappers cannot reveal secret canaries through Debug, Display, errors, provenance, effective references, or generated references.
One bounded seven-setting specification generates the checked JSON Schema and operator reference through cargo xtask generate-config.
EG-MATRIX fails when either generated configuration artifact differs from deterministic regeneration.
The authoritative EXT runner owns the registered M0-04 coverage report, 90 percent line and region floors, and the explicit exact-owner focused mutation campaign.
The extended workflow can retain the exact issue #5 campaign without broadening routine mutation selection.
The direct TOML dependency, exact version bans, lock resolution, Cargo Vet policy, and removal condition are registered and fail closed.
detection_lost_analysis: No gate, target, threshold identity, corpus, workflow retention path, owner, or evidence field is removed or weakened. The handwritten parser's rejection of standards-compliant comments and escapes was incorrect behavior, not a retained detector.
